## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: only Energy is showing sector-level strength while Big Tech and Financials are broadly BELOW TREND, and leadership is Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND; Energy breadth: 8/10 positive → Sector Strength. Materials showing pockets: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.11% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY — Materials breadth: 3/11 positive → Internal Rotation.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -11.12%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -14.69%) BELOW TREND — Financials breadth: 2/20 positive → Sector Weakness. Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND — Technology breadth: 5/24 positive → Sector Weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.11% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: BKNG (1W: -8.37% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND, TFC (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -18.66%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech/Healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W movers: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND; watch RECOVERYs APD (1W: +5.11% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY and ORCL (1W: +2.82% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY as short-term bounces. Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend breaks; treat as tactical rather than structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology in Sector Weakness: AAPL (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND; pockets of resilience: PANW (1W: +3.04% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +2.82% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY — Tech breadth: 5/24 positive → Sector Weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing broad weakness: JPM (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -11.12%) BELOW TREND, TFC (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -18.66%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -14.69%) BELOW TREND — Financials breadth: 2/20 positive → Sector Weakness; risk-sensitive names remain at risk until breadth improves.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare tilted lower but mixed: JNJ (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -4.50%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare breadth: 4/17 positive → Sector Weakness; watch JNJ on FDA-driven momentum.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Energy and selective Materials exposure given strong 1W momentum (OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to cyclical Financial names and large-cap Tech showing persistent BELOW TREND behavior (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective amid narrow leadership and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +9.13%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: BLK (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -14.69%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -19.01%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy — Sector Strength, Energy breadth: 8/10 positive.  
BEARISH: Financials and Technology — Sector Weakness; Financials breadth: 2/20 positive, Technology breadth: 5/24 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND — watch near-term resistance and failure to reclaim 1M downtrend as a trigger for further weakness.  
AAPL (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND — watch holds/loss of near-term support for larger cap selling pressure.  
OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND — confirmation above recent breakout levels would signal continuation of Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
DOW (+55): Citi PT hike cited; price confirming as DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
JNJ (+70): FDA approval headline; JNJ (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
AMZN (-60): EU VAT legal risk headline; AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with 1W weakness (confirming).  
ACN (-45): PT cut headline; ACN (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -18.60%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
SYK (-50): Order disruption/cyberattack headline; SYK (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials).  
Energy and select Materials showing relative strength — OXY (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +26.84%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +13.17%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: major divergence across large caps (AAPL (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +1.24%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -4.65%) RECOVERY) — watch trend breaks and news catalysts closely.
